title: Elden Ring
review: A masterpiece of open-world design. Every corner of the Lands Between hides a secret worth discovering.
description: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.
longDescription: Elden Ring is FromSoftware's largest and most ambitious game yet. It blends the signature challenging combat of the Souls series with a sprawling open world filled with castles, dungeons, and colossal bosses. The freedom to explore at your own pace, combined with deep RPG mechanics and a hauntingly beautiful world, makes it a once-in-a-generation experience.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
review: An extraordinary sequel that expands the world into the skies with incredible new mechanics.
description: An epic adventure across the land, sky, and depths of Hyrule.
longDescription: Tears of the Kingdom continues Link's journey in a Hyrule that now extends far beyond the surface. With the new Fuse and Ultrahand abilities, players can craft weapons, vehicles, and contraptions to solve puzzles and overcome challenges in imaginative ways. The freedom to explore the sky islands above and the dark depths below offers countless hours of discovery.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
review: The definitive modern CRPG. Choices matter enormously and the world reacts beautifully to every decision.
description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in this story-rich, party-based RPG.
longDescription: Baldur's Gate 3 is a landmark CRPG that brings the beloved Dungeons & Dragons 5e ruleset to life. It offers an almost absurd amount of player freedom — from character creation to narrative decisions that genuinely reshape the world. Turn-based tactical combat, memorable companions, and excellent voice acting make it an unforgettable journey.

title: God of War Ragnarök
review: A breathtaking conclusion to the Norse saga with emotional storytelling and brutal combat.
description: Kratos and Atreus journey to all Nine Realms to prevent Ragnarök.
longDescription: God of War Ragnarök picks up years after the events of its predecessor. Kratos must decide whether to submit to fate or fight against it as the Norse apocalypse looms. The game delivers spectacular set pieces, a deeper combat system with new weapons and abilities, and an emotionally resonant father-son story.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
review: One of the greatest RPGs ever made, with a living world and phenomenal storytelling.
description: Track the Child of Prophecy as Geralt of Rivia in a war-torn world.
longDescription: The Witcher 3 sets a benchmark for open-world RPGs. As professional monster hunter Geralt of Rivia, you roam the war-ravaged Northern Kingdoms in search of your adopted daughter. Side quests rival main quests in quality, the moral choices are genuinely gray, and the two massive expansion packs add even more unforgettable content.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
review: A sprawling, deeply atmospheric western with the most detailed open world ever created.
description: America, 1899. The end of the Wild West era has begun as outlaws are pursued.
longDescription: Red Dead Redemption 2 is Rockstar's epic tale of outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang. It combines stunning realism, a gripping narrative, and emergent gameplay from its incredibly detailed world. Whether hunting, fishing, or robbing a stagecoach, every moment feels alive.

title: Hollow Knight
review: A hand-drawn masterpiece that proves indie games can rival the best the genre has to offer.
description: Forge your own path in the vast, haunting kingdom of Hallownest.
longDescription: Hollow Knight is a beautifully crafted Metroidvania set in the fallen kingdom of Hallownest. Its hand-drawn art style, tight platforming, and challenging boss fights create an incredibly memorable atmosphere. Exploration is rewarded generously, and the lore is deep and mysterious.

title: The Last of Us Part II
review: An emotionally brutal and technically flawless sequel that pushes storytelling in games forward.
description: Five years after their dangerous journey, Ellie embarks on a path of vengeance.
longDescription: The Last of Us Part II is a polarizing and powerful narrative-driven action game. It explores themes of revenge, trauma, and empathy through a story told from multiple perspectives. The combat and stealth systems are among the best in the genre, and the cinematic presentation is unmatched.

title: Spider-Man 2
review: Web-swinging feels better than ever, and dual-protagonist storytelling keeps it fresh.
description: Peter Parker and Miles Morales fight to save New York as new threats emerge.
longDescription: Spider-Man 2 lets players switch between Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they protect New York City. The improved web-swinging with Web Wings makes traversal thrilling, while the symbiote suit adds new combat depth. It delivers spectacle at every turn.

title: Hades
review: A perfect roguelike where failure is part of an incredible, ever-evolving story.
description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash your way out of the Underworld.
longDescription: Hades redefines the roguelike genre by weaving its story directly into the death-and-retry loop. As Zagreus, son of Hades, you fight through the Underworld with ever-changing boons from the Olympian gods. The combat is fluid, the art style is gorgeous, and the writing is superb.

title: Horizon Forbidden West
review: A stunning post-apocalyptic open world with spectacular robot combat.
description: Join Aloy as she braves the Forbidden West to save the world once more.
longDescription: Horizon Forbidden West expands Aloy's world far beyond the lands of the first game. Gorgeous biomes, improved machine combat with new spear attacks and tools, and a compelling mystery keep players hooked. The sheer visual splendor on PS5 is jaw-dropping.

title: Celeste
review: A heartbreakingly personal story wrapped in the most precise platforming since Super Meat Boy.
description: Help Madeline survive the treacherous Celeste Mountain in this modern classic.
longDescription: Celeste is a tight, challenging platformer with a deeply emotional story about anxiety and self-acceptance. Each screen is a cleverly designed puzzle of jumps and dashes. Its assist mode makes the experience accessible to everyone, while optional hardcore challenges reward the dedicated.

title: Stardew Valley
review: The cozy farming sim that started a movement, filled with charm and boundless creativity.
description: Leave city life behind and build a thriving farm in Stardew Valley.
longDescription: Stardew Valley is a farming and life simulation game with heart. You can farm, fish, mine, raise animals, and build relationships with the townsfolk. Its relaxing loop, pixel art charm, and extensive mod support have made it a beloved mainstay for cozy gaming.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
review: A neon-drenched dystopia that has been transformed into a truly remarkable RPG.
description: Become a cyberpunk mercenary in the sprawling megacity of Night City.
longDescription: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world RPG set in the chaotic megacity of Night City. After years of updates and the excellent Phantom Liberty expansion, it has emerged as a deep role-playing experience with strong writing, immersive first-person combat, and one of the most atmospheric settings in gaming.

title: Minecraft
review: The best-selling game of all time proves that pure creativity is the ultimate mechanic.
description: Mine, craft, and build limitless worlds one block at a time.
longDescription: Minecraft is a sandbox game about breaking and placing blocks. It offers infinite worlds to explore, build, and survive in. Its simplicity masks enormous depth — from redstone engineering to open-ended multiplayer servers, it remains a cultural phenomenon.

title: Fortnite
review: A cultural juggernaut that keeps reinventing the battle royale genre.
description: Drop in, build, and battle for survival in the world's biggest battle royale.
longDescription: Fortnite is a free-to-play battle royale where 100 players fight until one remains. Its unique building mechanics set it apart, while frequent seasons, live events, and collaborations with major IPs keep the game eternally fresh.

title: Inside
review: A bleak, unforgettable, and perfectly crafted 3-hour thriller.
description: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project.
longDescription: Inside is a puzzle platformer from the makers of Limbo. It drops players into a dystopian world full of danger and dread. Atmospheric, mysterious, and strikingly rendered, it tells a haunting story without a single word of dialogue.

title: Dead Cells
review: A fluid, fast-paced roguelike that rewards skill and experimentation.
description: Explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle in this action-packed roguelike.
longDescription: Dead Cells combines the best elements of roguelikes and Metroidvania games. Players explore procedurally generated levels, battling enemies and collecting weapons and abilities. Its tight combat, permadeath mechanics, and constant progression make it addictive and rewarding.

title: Cuphead
review: A visually stunning, brutally difficult game that pays homage to 1930s cartoons.
description: Take on the Devil in this challenging run-and-gun platformer with a unique art style.
longDescription: Cuphead is a run-and-gun platformer known for its hand-drawn animation and jazz soundtrack. The game is notoriously difficult, with challenging boss fights and precise platforming. Its unique visual style and cooperative gameplay make it a standout title.

title: Resident Evil Village
review: A masterclass in horror that blends action and suspense with a chilling atmosphere.
description: Ethan Winters returns to face new horrors in a mysterious village.
longDescription: Resident Evil Village continues the story of Ethan Winters as he navigates a mysterious village filled with terrifying creatures and deadly traps.

title: Efootball 2026
review: The latest installment in the eFootball series, offering realistic football gameplay and improved graphics.
description: Experience the thrill of football with eFootball 2026.
longDescription: eFootball 2026 brings the excitement of football to your screen with realistic player movements, advanced tactics, and immersive stadium atmospheres.

title: fast and furious: street racing
review: An adrenaline-pumping racing game that captures the thrill of street racing.
description: Race through the streets in high-speed action with Fast and Furious: Street Racing.
longDescription: Fast and Furious: Street Racing delivers an immersive racing experience with realistic physics, customizable cars, and intense street racing action.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3
review: The latest installment in the Call of Duty franchise, delivering intense action and multiplayer experiences.
description: Engage in modern warfare with the latest Call of Duty game.
longDescription: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 offers a thrilling single-player campaign and competitive multiplayer modes, with cutting-edge graphics and gameplay mechanics.

title: Assassin's Creed: Valhalla
review: A Viking adventure that combines historical storytelling with open-world exploration.
description: Lead your clan to glory in the age of Vikings in Assassin's Creed: Valhalla.
longDescription: Assassin's Creed: Valhalla immerses players in the Viking era, offering a rich narrative, expansive open world, and dynamic combat system.
